dataset.name: Smoke set — five sessions
dataset.description: Five sessions and six questions across all three difficulty bands. Too small to measure anything and not meant to: it is the set you run end to end in seconds to check that a pipeline works before spending an hour on one that does not.

messages.content: Note to self: the espresso machine in the kitchen broke on Monday. Repair booked for Wednesday.
Noted — I'll remind you Tuesday evening.
Reminder: the spare office keys are in the blue tin on the top shelf, not in the drawer where they used to be.
Delivery: the parcel from Hälsa arrives on Thursday between 9 and 11. Someone has to be in.
Plant care: the fig tree needs watering twice a week in summer, once a week the rest of the year.
IT: the guest wifi password changed to harbour-lantern-42. The old one stopped working this morning.
Saved. Tell visitors at reception rather than by email.
